Expression:
ABS (
    DATEDIFF (
        Opportunities[Opportunity Created On],
        IF (
            ISBLANK ( Opportunities[CloseDate] ) = TRUE (),
            TODAY (),
            Opportunities[CloseDate]
        ),
        WEEK
    )
)

IF(
  ISBLANK('Opportunities'[Days Remaining In Pipeline]),
  BLANK(),
  INT('Opportunities'[Days Remaining In Pipeline] / 5) * 5
)
